# GitHub Copilot instructions

Before proposing or changing code, read and obey `/AGENTS.md`, `/docs/ai-governance/CYBORG_EXECUTOR.md`, and `/docs/ai-governance/OPERATING_DOCTRINE.md`. Enter engineering work through the repo-native `vibeschool-cyborg-executor`.

Treat those files and `.github/control-plane/policy.json` as binding repository governance. Do not claim completion, certification, merge readiness, or successful merge without current exact-head evidence. Do not activate production runtime, schedulers, publishing, payments, or consequential worker authority without explicit authorization and required gates.
